step: Open on the problem: the backlog nobody can work through
text: Every team has a queue like this: hundreds of requests, no owner, and no way to tell which ones matter. This view shows the open requests for one demo workspace.

step: Triage in one click, with the reason shown
text: One click sorts them by impact, and each one shows why it was ranked where it is, so a person can check it instead of starting from scratch.
